scope: iOS Simulator controlled native scenes; not independent third-party app or physical phone accuracy

han.temperature_selection: minimum complete native region negative log likelihood

latin.temperature_selection: minimum complete native region negative log likelihood

limitations: Screenshots are actual iOS Simulator frames; page text and layouts are generated.
No physical-device or natural third-party app screenshot accuracy is established.
Native glyph boxes isolate font classification; OCR detection/segmentation accuracy is measured separately.
Source-font synthetic checkpoint initializes parameters; all optimizer examples are native screenshot crops.

style_conditional_test.conditions: verified native glyph boxes and true font family; not end-to-end OCR/font-classification accuracy

comparison.decision_level: individual preprocessed calibration glyph; deployed ranking and gate code

parity.scope: Export/runtime parity on fixed preprocessed calibration glyphs, not an accuracy estimate.

legacy_regression.scope: controlled frozen rendered inputs only; no real-device font truth or device inference

api.transport: FastAPI TestClient in-process HTTP; no external server
